acceptanceCriteria: The export and verify bounds are consistent for a worst-case (incompressible) export at the byte bound, or the export refuses first; a test covers it.
body: Recorded limit from V1-1528 (PR #998, head 423545fed): maxExportTotalBytes is 512<<20 and verify.go keeps the 512 MiB compressed-archive bound, so a near-incompressible export at the byte bound could produce an archive the verifier refuses. Not observed; real source compresses far below it. Expected: either the compressed bound covers worst-case gzip expansion of a bound-sized export, or the export refuses before producing an unverifiable archive, with a test.

title: Companion export: an incompressible export at the 512 MiB byte bound can exceed the verifier's 512 MiB compressed-archive bound
